Decreased libido and erectile dysfunction for the past six months

- Hereditary Hemochromatosis (HFE-related)
- Hypertension

- Hemochromatosis-associated arthropathy

His past medical history is significant for type 2 diabetes mellitus and recurrent arthralgia.

- Wisdom teeth extraction (age 22)

MEDICATIONS:

- Lisinopril 20 mg PO daily
- Amlodipine 5 mg PO daily
- Acetaminophen 650 mg PO PRN pain

ALLERGIES:

SOCIAL HISTORY:

ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-01-15
Provider: Dr. Sarah Chen, MD
Department: Internal Medicine
Visit Type: outpatient

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Fatigue, increased thirst, and frequent urination over the past few weeks

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
A 45-year-old man comes to the clinic due to fatigue, increased thirst, and frequent urination over the past few weeks. but has gained 20 pounds over the last year.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
- Hereditary Hemochromatosis (HFE-related)
- Hypertension
- Obesity (Class II)
- Chronic lower back pain
- Hemochromatosis-associated arthropathy

PAST SURGICAL HISTORY:
- Wisdom teeth extraction (age 22)

MEDICATIONS:
Home Medications:
- Metformin 1000 mg PO twice daily
- Lisinopril 20 mg PO daily
- Amlodipine 5 mg PO daily
- Acetaminophen 650 mg PO PRN pain

ALLERGIES:
NKDA

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Father: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
- Paternal grandfather: Hemochromatosis with liver cirrhosis
- Mother: Hypertension
- Sister: Hemochromatosis carrier

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Former smoker (quit 3 years ago, 10 pack-year history). Alcohol: Social (1-2 drinks per week). Occupation: Warehouse logistics coordinator.

VITAL SIGNS:
His BMI is 32

LABORATORY DATA:
Laboratory tests reveal a fasting blood glucose of 156 mg/dL and a hemoglobin A1c of 7.5%. Fasting insulin levels are elevated, and C-peptide levels are within the normal-to-high range. A glucose tolerance test confirms impaired glucose uptake despite elevated insulin secretion.
